english: hard; not easy; you need to work hard to do it
primaryExample: Although the instructions looked difficult at first, we understood them once the teacher gave an example.
primaryTranslation: 虽然说明起初看起来很难，但老师举了一个例子后，我们就理解了。

english: you say this when you politely ask people for things
primaryExample: Could you please check the address before we leave, so that we do not get lost?
primaryTranslation: 出发前你能检查一下地址吗，这样我们就不会迷路了？

english: small part of something; tiny fact
primaryExample: The guide explained every detail of the route before our group began the mountain walk.
primaryTranslation: 我们的团队开始登山前，向导解释了路线的每一个细节。

english: not of the same kind; unlike other things
primaryExample: The main difference between the two courses is that one includes more opportunities to practise speaking.
primaryTranslation: 这两门课程的主要区别是，其中一门提供了更多练习口语的机会。

english: something that a person or thing does
primaryExample: After several complaints about the broken gate, the school finally took action to repair it.
primaryTranslation: 在收到几次关于大门损坏的投诉后，学校终于采取了修理行动。

english: being in a good condition; being well
primaryExample: Regular breaks can benefit your health, especially if your job involves sitting at a desk all day.
primaryTranslation: 经常休息对健康有益，尤其是当你的工作需要整天坐在办公桌前时。

english: to put food in your mouth
primaryExample: We usually eat together in the evening, even when everyone has had a particularly busy day.
primaryTranslation: 我们通常晚上一起吃饭，即使大家当天都特别忙。

english: flat horizontal piece that forms stairs
primaryExample: The lowest step was covered in wet leaves, so I held the rail as I went down.
primaryTranslation: 最下面一级台阶盖着湿树叶，所以我下楼时扶着栏杆。

english: agreeing with the facts; not false; real or actual
primaryExample: The story sounded unlikely, but several people who were there confirmed that it was true.
primaryTranslation: 这个故事听起来不太可信，但几位当时在场的人证实了它是真的。

english: to talk to someone using a telephone
primaryExample: Please phone the hotel before we arrive to ask whether our room will be ready early.
primaryTranslation: 请在我们到达前给酒店打电话，问问房间能否提前准备好。

english: reflexive form of they
primaryExample: The children prepared the picnic themselves, although their parents helped them carry everything to the park.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们自己准备了野餐，不过父母帮他们把所有东西搬到了公园。

english: to create an image using pen or pencil and paper
primaryExample: Our teacher asked us to draw a building that we could see from the classroom window.
primaryTranslation: 老师让我们画一栋从教室窗户能看到的建筑。

english: lightest color; the color of fresh snow and milk
primaryExample: She chose white curtains because they made the small bedroom look brighter during the winter months.
primaryTranslation: 她选了白色窗帘，因为它们让小卧室在冬季看起来更明亮。

english: a day in the calendar such as January 3rd
primaryExample: We agreed on a date for the meeting after checking when everyone would be available.
primaryTranslation: 查看了大家什么时候有空之后，我们商定了会议日期。

english: to do something many times to improve a skill
primaryExample: If you practice giving short talks regularly, you may feel more comfortable speaking in front of others.
primaryTranslation: 如果经常练习做简短演讲，你在别人面前说话时可能会更自在。

english: a copy that represents an object or standard
primaryExample: The students built a model of their town to show how the new bridge would look.
primaryTranslation: 学生们制作了一个城镇模型，展示新桥建成后的样子。

english: to increase a quantity, size, intensity or price
primaryExample: The cafe plans to raise its prices slightly because the cost of ingredients has increased.
primaryTranslation: 由于原料成本上涨，这家咖啡馆计划略微提价。

english: someone who buys goods or services from a business
primaryExample: A customer who had left her bag in the shop returned just before we closed.
primaryTranslation: 一位把包落在店里的顾客在我们关门前赶了回来。

english: opposite of back; the forward part of an object
primaryExample: Please use the front entrance, as the door at the back is being repaired today.
primaryTranslation: 请走前门，因为后门今天正在维修。

english: to make clear or easy to understand by describing
primaryExample: Could you explain how this machine works before I try using it for the first time?
primaryTranslation: 在我第一次尝试使用这台机器前，你能解释一下它如何运作吗？

english: you walk through this when you go in a room
primaryExample: I left a note on the door so that visitors would know where to find us.
primaryTranslation: 我在门上留了一张便条，好让访客知道去哪里找我们。

english: area around or near something, such as a building
primaryExample: The outside of the house needs painting, but the rooms inside are still in good condition.
primaryTranslation: 房子的外部需要粉刷，但里面的房间状况仍然很好。

english: in or toward the back
primaryExample: We had almost reached the station when I noticed that my younger brother had fallen behind.
primaryTranslation: 我们快到车站时，我才注意到弟弟落在了后面。

english: having to do with trade, industry, and money
primaryExample: The report describes the economic changes that have affected small businesses over the past five years.
primaryTranslation: 这份报告描述了过去五年影响小企业的经济变化。

english: present, former, or future location of something, such as a building
primaryExample: Before the builders arrived, experts visited the site to check whether the ground was suitable.
primaryTranslation: 建筑工人到来之前，专家去了工地，检查地面是否合适。

english: to get close to reaching something or somewhere
primaryExample: As we approach the village, you will see an old stone bridge on the left.
primaryTranslation: 当我们接近村庄时，你会在左边看到一座古老的石桥。

english: person who teaches others, especially in a school
primaryExample: Our science teacher encouraged us to test our ideas instead of simply accepting the answers.
primaryTranslation: 科学老师鼓励我们检验自己的想法，而不是简单地接受答案。

english: the earth; the ground
primaryExample: The farmer bought the land beside the river because it was suitable for growing vegetables.
primaryTranslation: 这位农民买下了河边的土地，因为那里适合种蔬菜。

english: to ask for money as a price for a service or goods
primaryExample: Some museums charge visitors an entrance fee, while others allow everyone to enter free of charge.
primaryTranslation: 有些博物馆向参观者收取门票费，而另一些允许所有人免费入内。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 向某人收取某物的费用

english: after a long time or some difficulty
primaryExample: After trying several different routes, we finally found a quiet path that led to the beach.
primaryTranslation: 尝试了几条不同的路线后，我们终于找到了一条通往海滩的安静小路。

english: something such as a mark or event that shows that something exists, is true, is happening or will happen
primaryExample: The first sign of trouble was a strange noise coming from the back of the car.
primaryTranslation: 出现问题的第一个迹象是汽车后部传来奇怪的响声。

english: to say something is true when others may not agree
primaryExample: The makers claim that this bag is waterproof, although we have not tested it in heavy rain.
primaryTranslation: 制造商声称这个包防水，不过我们还没有在大雨中测试过。

english: manner in which people, groups or countries behave toward one another
primaryExample: Their relationship improved after they began discussing problems calmly instead of blaming each other for mistakes.
primaryTranslation: 他们开始冷静地讨论问题，而不是因错误互相指责之后，关系改善了。

english: to go to a place that is far away
primaryExample: We prefer to travel by train when possible because it gives us time to enjoy the scenery.
primaryTranslation: 只要可能，我们更喜欢乘火车旅行，因为这样有时间欣赏风景。

english: to take pleasure in something
primaryExample: The children seemed to enjoy the museum visit more once they could try the activities themselves.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们能亲自动手尝试活动后，似乎更喜欢这次博物馆参观了。

english: when someone dies; the end of life
primaryExample: The writer's death was announced yesterday, and readers shared memories of how her books had inspired them.
primaryTranslation: 这位作家去世的消息昨天公布了，读者纷纷分享她的书如何启发自己的回忆。

english: good or enjoyable
primaryExample: It was nice to meet the neighbours properly after living next door to them for several months.
primaryTranslation: 和邻居做了几个月的邻居后，能正式认识他们真令人高兴。

english: quantity of something
primaryExample: The amount of water we use each day depends partly on how long we spend showering.
primaryTranslation: 我们每天的用水量部分取决于淋浴时间有多长。

english: to make, or become, something better
primaryExample: You can improve your listening skills by following short recordings and checking the words you miss.
primaryTranslation: 你可以跟着短录音听，并核对漏听的单词，来提高听力。

english: painting, drawing or photograph on paper or screen
primaryExample: The picture on the website looked different from the room we were actually given at the hotel.
primaryTranslation: 网站上的照片与酒店实际给我们的房间看起来不同。

english: a young male person
primaryExample: The boy who found the missing dog waited outside the library until its owner arrived.
primaryTranslation: 找到那只走失狗的男孩在图书馆外等着，直到狗主人到来。

english: to pay attention to someone or something
primaryExample: We regard safety as our first concern whenever we organize an activity for younger children outdoors.
primaryTranslation: 每当为年幼的孩子组织户外活动时，我们都把安全视为首要考虑。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 以尊重的态度看待某人

english: formal group of people with a particular purpose
primaryExample: The organization provides free books to families who cannot easily reach a library in their area.
primaryTranslation: 这个组织为无法方便地前往当地图书馆的家庭提供免费图书。

english: feeling pleasure or joy; glad
primaryExample: She was happy with the final design, even though it was quite different from her original idea.
primaryTranslation: 她对最终设计很满意，尽管它与最初的想法很不一样。

english: two of something; two people; a pair
primaryExample: A couple who live near the station offered us directions when they saw us studying the map.
primaryTranslation: 住在车站附近的一对夫妇看见我们研究地图，主动给我们指路。

english: to behave in a certain way
primaryExample: Try to act calmly if the plan changes, because the rest of the group will follow your example.
primaryTranslation: 如果计划改变，尽量保持冷静，因为团队其他人会以你为榜样。

english: limits within which something extends or varies
primaryExample: The shop offers a wide range of equipment, from simple tools to machines for professional use.
primaryTranslation: 这家商店提供种类丰富的设备，从简单工具到专业机器应有尽有。

english: high level of worth or excellence
primaryExample: The quality of the recording improved considerably after we moved the microphone closer to the speaker.
primaryTranslation: 我们把麦克风移近说话的人之后，录音质量明显改善了。

english: a planned piece of work for specific purpose
primaryExample: Our class started a project to discover how much food the school throws away each week.
primaryTranslation: 我们班开展了一个项目，调查学校每周丢弃多少食物。

english: being in the shape of a circle or ball
primaryExample: We sat at a round table so that everyone could see and hear each other easily.
primaryTranslation: 我们坐在一张圆桌旁，这样大家都能轻松看到和听到彼此。

english: time/situation when a thing might be done; chance
primaryExample: The exchange programme gave her an opportunity to practise English with people from several different countries.
primaryTranslation: 这个交流项目给了她与来自几个不同国家的人练习英语的机会。

english: long piece of hard land for cars to travel on
primaryExample: The road to the village was closed after heavy rain, so we had to choose another route.
primaryTranslation: 大雨过后，通往村庄的道路被封闭了，所以我们不得不另选路线。

english: agreement or harmony
primaryExample: The two towns signed an accord to share public transport services and reduce the cost of travel.
primaryTranslation: 这两个城镇签署了协议，共享公共交通服务并降低出行成本。

english: series of written names, words or numbers
primaryExample: Before we went shopping, I made a list of everything we needed for the weekend trip.
primaryTranslation: 购物之前，我列出了周末旅行所需所有物品的清单。

english: to want something to happen or to become true
primaryExample: I wish I had asked more questions when my grandparents told me stories about their childhood.
primaryTranslation: 祖父母给我讲童年故事时，我真希望自己当时多问一些问题。

english: for that reason
primaryExample: The bridge is closed for repairs; therefore, all buses must take a longer route through the town.
primaryTranslation: 这座桥因维修而关闭；因此，所有公交车都必须走穿过城镇的较长路线。

english: to have clothes, glasses, shoes, etc., on your body
primaryExample: You should wear comfortable shoes because the tour includes a long walk through the old town.
primaryTranslation: 你应该穿舒适的鞋，因为行程包括长时间步行穿过老城区。

english: (v) to supply (n) money for something
primaryExample: The school created a fund to help students who could not afford to join the trip.
primaryTranslation: 学校设立了一项基金，帮助无力支付费用参加旅行的学生。

english: time when one relaxes, sleeps, or is inactive
primaryExample: After carrying the boxes upstairs, we needed a short rest before starting to unpack them carefully.
primaryTranslation: 把箱子搬上楼后，我们需要稍作休息，再开始小心地拆箱。

english: informal child or young person
primaryExample: Every kid in the group was given a small task so that nobody felt left out.
primaryTranslation: 小组里的每个孩子都分到了一项小任务，这样就没有人觉得被冷落。

english: factories or businesses that make certain products
primaryExample: The fishing industry provides many jobs in the town, although tourism is becoming increasingly important too.
primaryTranslation: 渔业为这个城镇提供了许多工作，尽管旅游业也变得日益重要。

english: process of giving or receiving teaching
primaryExample: Access to a good education can give young people more choices when they begin their working lives.
primaryTranslation: 获得良好教育能让年轻人在开始工作生涯时拥有更多选择。

english: to calculate size, weight or temperature of
primaryExample: Please measure the window carefully before ordering curtains, since the old ones were much too short.
primaryTranslation: 订购窗帘前，请仔细测量窗户，因为旧窗帘实在太短了。

english: to end the life of a person or other living thing
primaryExample: The sudden frost can kill young plants, so the gardener covers them when cold nights are expected.
primaryTranslation: 突如其来的霜冻会使幼苗死亡，所以预计夜晚寒冷时，园丁会盖住它们。

english: to give or provide something to another person
primaryExample: The volunteers serve warm meals to visitors who have spent the whole morning walking in the cold.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者为整个上午都在寒冷中行走的访客提供热饭。

english: referring to the chance that something will actually happen
primaryExample: The train is likely to be crowded because several large events are taking place this weekend.
primaryTranslation: 火车很可能很拥挤，因为本周末会举行几场大型活动。

english: definitely true or is sure to happen
primaryExample: We certainly enjoyed the concert, although the journey home took much longer than we had expected.
primaryTranslation: 我们确实很喜欢这场音乐会，尽管回家花的时间比预想长得多。

english: concerning a nation as a whole
primaryExample: The painting will remain in the national museum until the exhibition moves to another city next spring.
primaryTranslation: 这幅画将留在国家博物馆，直到展览明年春天移至另一座城市。

english: referring to it
primaryExample: The machine switches itself off when the water reaches the right temperature, which helps save energy.
primaryTranslation: 水达到适当温度时，这台机器会自动关闭，这有助于节能。

english: to help someone learn or do something
primaryExample: My grandfather used to teach us how to repair simple tools rather than immediately buying new ones.
primaryTranslation: 祖父过去常教我们如何修理简单工具，而不是马上买新的。

english: open area of land, especially without buildings
primaryExample: We crossed a field of yellow flowers before reaching the narrow path that led towards the lake.
primaryTranslation: 我们穿过一片开着黄花的田野，才到达通往湖边的狭窄小路。

english: things done to protect people, buildings, a country, etc., from harm
primaryExample: Airport security was unusually busy that morning, so we arrived earlier to allow enough time for checks.
primaryTranslation: 那天早晨机场安检异常繁忙，所以我们提早到达，留出足够的检查时间。

english: mixture of gases around the earth that we breathe
primaryExample: Fresh air came through the open windows while we waited for the afternoon meeting to begin.
primaryTranslation: 我们等待下午会议开始时，新鲜空气从敞开的窗户吹了进来。

english: good result or effect, something advantageous
primaryExample: One benefit of joining the club is that you can learn from people with more experience.
primaryTranslation: 加入这个俱乐部的一个好处是，你可以向经验更丰富的人学习。

english: to buy, sell and exchange goods in business
primaryExample: The two villages used to trade goods at a weekly market before a road connected them.
primaryTranslation: 在一条道路将它们连接起来之前，这两个村庄过去每周在集市交易货物。

english: to take the chance that you may do something dangerous
primaryExample: We decided not to risk missing the last train, even though the concert had not finished.
primaryTranslation: 尽管音乐会还没有结束，我们还是决定不冒错过末班火车的风险。

english: information about recent events
primaryExample: The news about the new library pleased residents who had campaigned for better local services for years.
primaryTranslation: 有关新图书馆的消息让多年来争取改善当地服务的居民感到高兴。

english: accepted level of quality; an official measurement
primaryExample: The room includes all the standard equipment, but you must request a projector before the meeting.
primaryTranslation: 房间包括所有标准设备，但你必须在会议前申请投影仪。

english: to make a choice for or against, as in an election
primaryExample: Club members will vote on the proposal after everyone has had a chance to ask questions.
primaryTranslation: 待每个人都有机会提问后，俱乐部成员将对这个提议进行投票。

english: one one-hundredth of a whole
primaryExample: Almost twenty percent of the students cycle to school, according to the survey we completed last month.
primaryTranslation: 根据我们上个月完成的调查，将近百分之二十的学生骑车上学。

english: main purpose or center of interest or activity
primaryExample: The main focus of our discussion was how to make the school garden easier to maintain.
primaryTranslation: 我们讨论的重点是如何让学校花园更容易维护。

english: place where actors or musician perform for others
primaryExample: The musicians waited behind the stage until the audience had taken their seats and the lights dimmed.
primaryTranslation: 音乐家们在舞台后等待，直到观众就座、灯光暗下。

english: empty area with nothing in it
primaryExample: We moved the desk beside the window to create more space in the middle of the room.
primaryTranslation: 我们把书桌移到窗边，以便在房间中央腾出更多空间。

english: when one thing is replaced by another
primaryExample: The weather was too wet for a picnic, so we invited everyone to our house instead.
primaryTranslation: 天气太湿，不适合野餐，所以我们改为邀请大家到我们家来。

english: to become aware of or understand mentally
primaryExample: I did not realize how much the town had changed until I visited my old school.
primaryTranslation: 直到参观了母校，我才意识到这个城镇变化有多大。

english: normally; regularly
primaryExample: We usually buy our vegetables at the market, although we sometimes use the supermarket when it rains.
primaryTranslation: 我们通常在市场买蔬菜，不过下雨时有时会去超市。

english: facts or information used to calculate or analyze
primaryExample: The team collected data from several schools before deciding which changes might improve students' learning experiences.
primaryTranslation: 团队在决定哪些改变可能改善学生的学习体验之前，收集了几所学校的数据。

english: only, merely
primaryExample: There was not a single empty seat when we entered the hall just before the performance.
primaryTranslation: 演出开始前，我们进入大厅时，一个空座位也没有。

english: exact street location of a place
primaryExample: Please write your full address clearly so that the parcel can be delivered without any delay.
primaryTranslation: 请清楚地写下完整地址，以便包裹能毫无延误地送达。

english: activity done to entertain an audience
primaryExample: Her performance was particularly impressive because she had only learned the difficult piece a few weeks earlier.
primaryTranslation: 她的演出特别精彩，因为她仅在几周前才学会这首难曲。

english: possibility that something will happen
primaryExample: There is a good chance that we will finish early if everyone brings the materials we need.
primaryTranslation: 如果每个人都带齐所需材料，我们很有可能提前完成。

english: to agree to receive or take something offered
primaryExample: She decided to accept the offer after considering how the new role would affect her family.
primaryTranslation: 考虑了新职位对家庭的影响后，她决定接受这个录用邀请。

english: community of people living together
primaryExample: Public libraries play an important role in society by giving people free access to information and ideas.
primaryTranslation: 公共图书馆让人们免费获取信息和思想，在社会中发挥着重要作用。

english: use or knowledge of science in industry, engineering, etc.
primaryExample: New technology allows us to share documents instantly, even when our colleagues are working in different countries.
primaryTranslation: 新技术让我们能够即时分享文件，即使同事们正在不同国家工作。

english: to refer to or talk or write about something
primaryExample: Please mention any food allergies when you book, so that the restaurant can prepare a suitable meal.
primaryTranslation: 预订时请说明是否有食物过敏，以便餐馆准备合适的饭菜。

english: decision between two or more possibilities
primaryExample: We had a choice between taking the early bus and paying more for a direct train.
primaryTranslation: 我们可以选择乘早班公交车，或多花钱坐直达火车。

english: to rescue someone or something from a bad situation
primaryExample: The quick response of the volunteers helped save several animals that had become trapped by the flood.
primaryTranslation: 志愿者的迅速反应帮助救出了几只被洪水困住的动物。

english: typical, normal; not unusual
primaryExample: It is common for visitors to get lost here because several streets have very similar names.
primaryTranslation: 游客在这里迷路很常见，因为几条街道的名字十分相似。

english: beliefs and customs of a particular group
primaryExample: Learning about another culture can help us understand why people communicate and celebrate in different ways.
primaryTranslation: 了解另一种文化可以帮助我们理解，人们为什么以不同方式交流和庆祝。

english: whole number or amount of something
primaryExample: The total includes breakfast and transport, so you will not need to pay extra for those services.
primaryTranslation: 总价包括早餐和交通，所以你不必为这些服务额外付费。

english: to strongly request someone to do something; insist
primaryExample: Residents demand better lighting along the path because several people have fallen there after dark this winter.
primaryTranslation: 居民强烈要求改善小路的照明，因为今年冬天已有几人在天黑后在那里摔倒。

english: substance from which a thing is made of
primaryExample: The designer chose a light material that would keep the jacket comfortable even in warm weather.
primaryTranslation: 设计师选了一种轻薄材料，让夹克即使在暖和天气里穿着也舒适。

english: point beyond which it is not possible to go
primaryExample: There is a limit to how many visitors the island can welcome without damaging its natural environment.
primaryTranslation: 在不破坏自然环境的前提下，这座岛能接待的游客数量是有限的。

english: to use your ears to hear and understand things
primaryExample: If you listen carefully to the instructions, you will find the activity much easier to complete.
primaryTranslation: 如果仔细听说明，你会发现完成这项活动容易得多。

english: when something is required or expected
primaryExample: The final report is due on Friday, so we need to check all the figures before then.
primaryTranslation: 最终报告周五到期，所以我们需要在那之前核对所有数字。

english: not right, incorrect; not true; bad
primaryExample: We took the wrong turning after the bridge, which added another twenty minutes to our journey.
primaryTranslation: 过桥后我们拐错了弯，这使行程又增加了二十分钟。

english: lowest part of the leg we use to stand on
primaryExample: She hurt her foot during the walk, so we stopped at a cafe while she rested.
primaryTranslation: 她步行时伤了脚，所以我们停在咖啡馆，让她休息。

english: amount of work used trying to do something
primaryExample: The whole team made an effort to finish the display before the first visitors arrived that morning.
primaryTranslation: 整个团队努力赶在那天早晨首批访客到来前完成展品布置。

english: focus of your thoughts on something
primaryExample: The guide asked for our attention before explaining which parts of the castle were open to visitors.
primaryTranslation: 导游请大家注意听，然后解释城堡哪些部分对游客开放。

english: more formal term for on
primaryExample: Upon entering the room, we noticed a handwritten message resting upon the table beside the window.
primaryTranslation: 一进房间，我们就注意到窗边桌子上放着一张手写便条。

english: to confirm the details of something are correct
primaryExample: We should check whether the tickets include luggage before we decide which train service to book.
primaryTranslation: 在决定预订哪班火车前，我们应该核实票价是否包含行李费用。

english: to finish or reach the end of doing something
primaryExample: The students worked in pairs to complete the experiment before comparing their results with another group.
primaryTranslation: 学生们两人一组完成实验，然后与另一组比较结果。

english: to say something that you know is not true
primaryExample: He decided not to lie about the broken window because he knew someone else might be blamed.
primaryTranslation: 他决定不为打破窗户的事撒谎，因为他知道别人可能会受到责怪。

english: to decide on a thing from various choices; select
primaryExample: You can pick a topic that interests you, provided there is enough information available for your research.
primaryTranslation: 你可以选择自己感兴趣的话题，前提是有足够的信息可用于研究。

english: to make something smaller or use less of it
primaryExample: We hope to reduce food waste by planning meals carefully and using ingredients that are already available.
primaryTranslation: 我们希望通过仔细安排餐食并利用现有食材来减少食物浪费。

english: of or about a particular person
primaryExample: She prefers to keep her personal photographs off public websites, although she shares them with close friends.
primaryTranslation: 她倾向于不把私人照片放到公开网站上，不过会与好友分享。

english: solid surface of the earth that we stand on
primaryExample: The ground was still wet from the overnight rain, so we spread a waterproof sheet beneath the picnic blanket.
primaryTranslation: 夜雨过后地面仍然湿着，所以我们在野餐毯下面铺了一张防水布。

english: a living creature that is not a plant or person
primaryExample: The guide reminded us not to approach any animal that appeared nervous or was protecting its young.
primaryTranslation: 导游提醒我们，不要靠近显得紧张或正在保护幼崽的动物。

english: to reach the place you are travelling to
primaryExample: If we arrive before the museum opens, we can have breakfast at the cafe across the road.
primaryTranslation: 如果在博物馆开门前到达，我们可以在马路对面的咖啡馆吃早餐。

english: not getting annoyed when things take a long time
primaryExample: Our instructor remained patient while we practised the difficult movement, even though we kept making mistakes.
primaryTranslation: 我们练习那个困难动作时，教练一直很有耐心，尽管我们总是犯错。

english: happening or being in the present time
primaryExample: The current timetable leaves little time for discussion, so we are considering making each session longer.
primaryTranslation: 目前的时间表几乎没有留讨论时间，所以我们正考虑延长每场活动。

english: period of 100 years
primaryExample: The bridge was built over a century ago, yet it still carries traffic through the town every day.
primaryTranslation: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前，但每天仍有车辆从桥上穿城而过。

english: factual proof that helps to establish the truth
primaryExample: The team needed more evidence before they could explain why the river water had changed colour.
primaryTranslation: 团队需要更多证据，才能解释河水为什么变了颜色。

english: to be present, alive or real
primaryExample: Some traditional skills still exist in this village because older residents continue to teach them to children.
primaryTranslation: 这个村庄仍保留着一些传统技艺，因为年长居民一直把它们传授给孩子。

english: nearly the same
primaryExample: The two paintings look similar from a distance, but their colours are quite different when viewed closely.
primaryTranslation: 远看这两幅画像很相似，但近看时，它们的颜色差别很大。

english: act of trying to hurt someone by hitting them
primaryExample: A fight broke out after the match, but the players quickly helped the coach calm everyone down.
primaryTranslation: 比赛后发生了一场打斗，但队员们很快帮助教练让所有人冷静下来。

english: person who is in charge of a group or task
primaryExample: A good leader listens to different opinions before deciding how the group should deal with a problem.
primaryTranslation: 优秀的领导者会先听取不同意见，再决定团队该如何处理问题。

english: good, acceptable or satisfactory
primaryExample: The room was small but perfectly fine for our needs, since we spent most of the day outside.
primaryTranslation: 房间虽小，但完全能满足需求，因为我们一天大部分时间都在外面。

english: road in a city with buildings and places to walk
primaryExample: The street becomes quieter in the evening, when the market stalls close and most visitors leave.
primaryTranslation: 到了晚上，市场摊位关闭、大多数游客离开时，这条街就安静下来。

english: being something previously, but not now
primaryExample: A former teacher returned to the school to describe how the neighbourhood had changed over the years.
primaryTranslation: 一位前任教师回到学校，讲述这个社区多年来如何变化。

english: to get in touch with someone
primaryExample: Please contact the organiser if your plans change, so that your place can be offered to someone else.
primaryTranslation: 如果计划有变，请联系组织者，以便把你的名额让给别人。

english: specially; more than others
primaryExample: The path is particularly beautiful in autumn, when the leaves turn gold and fewer visitors are around.
primaryTranslation: 秋天树叶变成金色、游客减少时，这条小路尤其美丽。

english: married woman
primaryExample: His wife suggested taking the earlier train because it would give them more time to explore the city.
primaryTranslation: 他的妻子建议坐更早的火车，因为这样能给他们更多时间探索城市。

english: game or physical exercise with rules
primaryExample: Trying a new sport can be a good way to meet people, even if you are not competitive.
primaryTranslation: 尝试一项新运动可以是结识朋友的好方法，即使你并不好胜。

english: to make something ready for use
primaryExample: We need to prepare a few questions before the interview so that we can use the time well.
primaryTranslation: 面试前我们需要准备几个问题，以便充分利用时间。

english: to talk about something seriously or in great detail
primaryExample: The committee will discuss the proposal next week, after members have had time to read the full report.
primaryTranslation: 委员们有时间阅读完整报告之后，委员会将于下周讨论这个提案。

english: something said or written as an answer to something
primaryExample: We have not received a response to our invitation, although the event is now less than a week away.
primaryTranslation: 虽然距离活动已不到一周，我们仍未收到邀请的回复。

english: sound made when you speak or sing
primaryExample: She lowered her voice when she entered the library, where several students were preparing for an exam.
primaryTranslation: 她进入图书馆时压低了声音，那里有几名学生正在准备考试。

english: small part that of something larger
primaryExample: Each student chose a piece of coloured paper and folded it into a shape of their own design.
primaryTranslation: 每个学生选了一张彩纸，把它折成自己设计的形状。

english: end of something; completion
primaryExample: The race had a surprising finish, as the youngest runner passed two experienced competitors near the end.
primaryTranslation: 这场比赛的结局出人意料，最年轻的选手在接近终点时超过了两名经验丰富的对手。

english: to imagine or guess what might happen
primaryExample: I suppose we could move the meeting online if the weather prevents people from travelling safely.
primaryTranslation: 如果天气使大家无法安全出行，我想我们可以把会议改为在线举行。

english: to ask formally for (a job, building permission, etc.)
primaryExample: She decided to apply for the training course after discovering that it included several practical workshops.
primaryTranslation: 得知培训课程包含几场实践工作坊后，她决定申请参加。

english: person in charge of a country, company, or organization
primaryExample: The club president welcomed the new members before explaining how they could take part in future events.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部会长先欢迎新成员，然后解释他们可以如何参加今后的活动。

english: heat and the flame produced when burning
primaryExample: We kept the fire small because there was little dry wood left after the rainstorm.
primaryTranslation: 暴雨过后剩下的干木头不多了，所以我们把火控制得很小。

english: to consider how similar and different things are
primaryExample: Before buying a new laptop, compare the features that matter most to the work you actually do.
primaryTranslation: 购买新笔记本电脑之前，比较一下对你实际工作最重要的那些功能。

english: large, flat area, to play tennis or basketball
primaryExample: The basketball court behind the school is open to local families when lessons have finished for the day.
primaryTranslation: 学校后面的篮球场在当天课程结束后向当地家庭开放。

english: people, often in uniforms, who solve crimes
primaryExample: The police asked anyone who had seen the missing bicycle to contact the local station directly.
primaryTranslation: 警方请所有见过那辆丢失自行车的人直接联系当地警察局。

english: place where you can go to buy things
primaryExample: The store stays open later on Fridays so that people can shop after they finish work.
primaryTranslation: 这家商店周五营业到更晚，方便人们下班后购物。

english: without money; not rich
primaryExample: The charity works with poor families who need help buying school clothes and other essential items.
primaryTranslation: 这家慈善机构帮助需要资助购买校服等必需品的贫困家庭。

english: information, understanding, or skill
primaryExample: Her knowledge of local history made the walk more interesting than simply following a map would have been.
primaryTranslation: 她对当地历史的了解，让这次步行比单纯照着地图走更有趣。

english: to make a happy sound when something is funny
primaryExample: We could not help but laugh when the dog proudly carried our empty picnic basket back home.
primaryTranslation: 狗得意地提着空野餐篮回家时，我们都忍不住笑了。

english: part of your body from your shoulder to your hand
primaryExample: She carried the books under one arm while using her other hand to open the classroom door.
primaryTranslation: 她一只胳膊夹着书，另一只手用来打开教室门。

english: part of the body that pumps blood
primaryExample: During the science lesson, we learned how the heart pumps blood around the body throughout the day.
primaryTranslation: 科学课上，我们学习了心脏如何全天将血液泵送到全身。

english: produces or provides what is wanted or needed
primaryExample: The village well used to be the main source of drinking water before pipes reached every house.
primaryTranslation: 在管道通到每家每户之前，村里的水井曾是主要饮用水来源。

english: person who works for someone else for payment
primaryExample: Every new employee attends a short course that explains the company's safety rules and working procedures.
primaryTranslation: 每位新员工都会参加一门短期课程，了解公司的安全规则和工作流程。

english: to run or operate a business by directing others
primaryExample: She learned to manage the cafe by working alongside her aunt, who had run it for years.
primaryTranslation: 她与经营咖啡馆多年的姑姑一起工作，从而学会了如何管理咖啡馆。

english: in an easy or clear manner
primaryExample: The instructions explain the process simply, so you do not need any previous experience to follow them.
primaryTranslation: 说明用简单的方式解释了流程，所以无需任何经验也能照着操作。

english: a financial institution that keeps or lends money
primaryExample: We went to the bank to ask which account would be suitable for saving money regularly.
primaryTranslation: 我们去银行询问哪种账户适合定期储蓄。

english: fairly hard or solid, not soft
primaryExample: The mattress was too firm for my sister, so the hotel offered her a softer one.
primaryTranslation: 床垫对我姐姐来说太硬了，所以酒店给她换了一张更软的。

english: short for 'cellphone'
primaryExample: My cell phone had no signal inside the building, so I stepped outside to call the driver.
primaryTranslation: 我的手机在楼里没有信号，所以我走到外面给司机打电话。

english: piece of writing about a particular subject
primaryExample: The article explains why some birds return to the same garden every year, despite travelling enormous distances.
primaryTranslation: 这篇文章解释了为什么有些鸟尽管迁徙很远，每年仍返回同一个花园。

english: moving or able to move quickly
primaryExample: The river was too fast for our small boat, so the instructor chose a calmer section.
primaryTranslation: 河水流速对我们的小船来说太快，所以教练选了一段更平缓的河道。

english: to try to destroy, beat, or injure
primaryExample: The smaller animal will only attack if it cannot escape or thinks its young are in danger.
primaryTranslation: 这种较小的动物只有在无法逃走或认为幼崽有危险时才会攻击。

english: being of a different place or country
primaryExample: Studying a foreign language can help you understand everyday customs when you travel to another country.
primaryTranslation: 学习外语可以帮助你在去另一个国家旅行时理解当地日常习俗。

english: to do something that another person didn't expect
primaryExample: The children hoped to surprise their teacher by decorating the classroom before she arrived that morning.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们希望在老师那天早晨到来前装饰好教室，给她一个惊喜。

english: distinctive or important point of something
primaryExample: One useful feature of the app is that it saves your work even without an internet connection.
primaryTranslation: 这款应用的一项实用功能是，即使没有网络连接也能保存你的工作。

english: something that influences a result
primaryExample: Cost was an important factor in our decision, but we also considered how long the equipment would last.
primaryTranslation: 费用是我们决策中的重要因素，但我们也考虑了设备能使用多久。

english: being attractive to the eye in a simple way
primaryExample: The village square looked particularly pretty when the evening lights came on around the old stone fountain.
primaryTranslation: 傍晚，古老石喷泉周围的灯亮起时，村庄广场显得格外漂亮。

english: just a while ago; not long ago
primaryExample: The library recently introduced longer opening hours after students asked for somewhere quiet to study after school.
primaryTranslation: 学生们希望放学后有个安静的学习场所，因此图书馆最近延长了开放时间。

english: to do something that changes something else
primaryExample: The roadworks may affect your journey to school, particularly if you usually travel during the morning rush hour.
primaryTranslation: 道路施工可能影响你上学的路程，尤其是当你通常在早高峰出行时。

english: to let something fall from your hand
primaryExample: Be careful not to drop the glass bowl while you carry it across the wet kitchen floor.
primaryTranslation: 端着玻璃碗走过湿漉漉的厨房地板时，小心别把它掉在地上。

english: happening or beginning not long ago
primaryExample: The recent changes to the timetable have made it easier for people to reach the hospital.
primaryTranslation: 最近的时刻表调整让人们更容易到达医院。

english: to make, find, or show a connection between two or more things
primaryExample: The exercise asks us to relate the ideas in the article to problems in our own community.
primaryTranslation: 这项练习要求我们把文章中的观点与自己社区的问题联系起来。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 将某事与某事联系起来

english: of or done by someone in authority; formal
primaryExample: We waited for an official announcement before telling our customers that the event had been postponed.
primaryTranslation: 我们等到正式公告发布后，才告诉顾客活动已延期。

english: involving money
primaryExample: The group needs financial support to repair the old hall and keep it open for community activities.
primaryTranslation: 这个团体需要资金支持，以修缮旧礼堂并让它继续用于社区活动。

english: to be too late to ride on something (e.g., train or bus)
primaryExample: We left the exhibition early because we did not want to miss the last bus home.
primaryTranslation: 我们提前离开展览，因为不想错过回家的末班公交车。

english: a creative skill using the imagination (e.g., painting)
primaryExample: The exhibition combines art and science by showing how artists use light to create surprising effects.
primaryTranslation: 这场展览展示艺术家如何利用光线创造惊人效果，将艺术与科学结合起来。

english: to work in an organized and active way toward a goal
primaryExample: Local residents campaign for safer crossings because many children walk along the main road to school.
primaryTranslation: 当地居民为更安全的人行横道开展活动，因为许多孩子沿主路步行上学。

english: personal; not to be seen by everyone
primaryExample: The hotel has a private garden where guests can relax away from the noise of the main street.
primaryTranslation: 这家酒店有一座私家花园，客人可以远离主街噪声，在那里放松。

english: to stop doing for a while before continuing
primaryExample: The speaker decided to pause for a moment so that the audience could study the diagram carefully.
primaryTranslation: 演讲者决定暂停片刻，让观众能仔细研究图示。

english: every person; everybody
primaryExample: Everyone who joined the trip was asked to bring water, as there were no shops along the route.
primaryTranslation: 所有参加旅行的人都被要求带水，因为沿途没有商店。

english: to not remember something
primaryExample: Do not forget to save your work before leaving, especially if the computer is shared with other students.
primaryTranslation: 离开前别忘了保存工作，尤其是当这台电脑与其他学生共用时。

english: one side of a sheet of paper
primaryExample: On the last page of the booklet, you will find a map showing all the walking routes.
primaryTranslation: 在小册子的最后一页，你会找到一张标有所有步行路线的地图。

english: (v) to cause (n) the feeling that something bad or unpleastant might happen
primaryExample: Try not to worry about making mistakes, because they can help you notice what you need to practise.
primaryTranslation: 尽量别担心犯错，因为错误可以帮助你发现需要练习什么。

english: part of the year when the weather is hot
primaryExample: We spent the summer helping our grandparents repair their house before they moved back in that autumn.
primaryTranslation: 那个夏天，我们帮祖父母修房子，之后他们在秋天搬了回去。

english: to put water in your body through your mouth
primaryExample: After walking for several hours in warm weather, we stopped to drink water in the shade.
primaryTranslation: 在暖和的天气里走了几个小时后，我们停在阴凉处喝水。

english: a person's thoughts on a topic
primaryExample: In my opinion, the best part of the course was being able to practise with other learners.
primaryTranslation: 我认为，这门课程最棒的地方是能够与其他学习者一起练习。

english: to put your car or bike in a certain place for a time
primaryExample: You can park behind the library, provided you leave enough space for the delivery van to pass.
primaryTranslation: 你可以把车停在图书馆后面，前提是留下足够的空间让送货车通过。

english: to stand in the place or to act the part of
primaryExample: Two students will represent our class at the meeting and explain the changes we would like to see.
primaryTranslation: 两名学生将代表我们班参加会议，说明我们希望看到的改变。

english: something you use to open a lock or start a car
primaryExample: I gave my neighbour a spare key so that she could water the plants while we were away.
primaryTranslation: 我给邻居一把备用钥匙，方便她在我们外出时给植物浇水。

english: being in something
primaryExample: The inside pockets are large enough to hold a phone, which makes the jacket useful for travelling.
primaryTranslation: 内侧口袋大到足以装下手机，这让这件夹克很适合旅行。

english: person who controls and runs a business or group
primaryExample: The manager asked the team for suggestions before deciding how to improve the shop's opening hours.
primaryTranslation: 经理在决定如何调整商店营业时间前，向团队征求了建议。

english: done or relating to several countries, not just your own
primaryExample: The town hosts an international music festival that attracts performers and visitors from many different countries.
primaryTranslation: 这个城镇举办国际音乐节，吸引来自许多不同国家的表演者和游客。

english: to hold something inside something else
primaryExample: The box may contain fragile items, so please keep it upright while carrying it upstairs carefully.
primaryTranslation: 箱内可能装有易碎品，所以小心往楼上搬时请保持竖直。

english: to become aware by sight, touch, or hearing
primaryExample: Did you notice the new sign near the entrance, which explains where bicycles should be left?
primaryTranslation: 你注意到入口附近那块新指示牌了吗？上面说明了自行车应停在哪里。

english: surprise caused by experiencing something amazing
primaryExample: The children watched in wonder as the butterfly slowly opened its wings and flew towards the window.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们惊奇地看着蝴蝶慢慢展开翅膀，飞向窗户。

english: physical world, including plants, animals, rocks
primaryExample: Spending time in nature helps me relax, especially after a week of working inside a busy office.
primaryTranslation: 在大自然中度过时光有助于我放松，尤其是在繁忙办公室工作一周之后。

english: way something is built, arranged, or organized
primaryExample: The structure of the building allows plenty of light to enter without making the rooms too hot.
primaryTranslation: 这栋建筑的结构让大量光线进入，同时不会使房间过热。

english: one of the parts that form something
primaryExample: Read the final section carefully because it explains what to do if the machine stops working.
primaryTranslation: 仔细阅读最后一节，因为它解释了机器停止运转时该怎么做。

english: same person as did the action mentioned
primaryExample: I made the shelves myself, although a friend showed me how to use the tools safely first.
primaryTranslation: 这些架子是我自己做的，不过一位朋友事先教我如何安全使用工具。

english: no more and no less than; precisely
primaryExample: Please tell me exactly where you left the bag, so that I can help you look for it.
primaryTranslation: 请准确告诉我你把包放在哪里了，这样我才能帮你找。

english: living thing with leaves and roots growing in soil
primaryExample: The plant beside my window grows towards the light, so I turn its pot every few days.
primaryTranslation: 窗边的植物朝着光线生长，所以我每隔几天就转动一下花盆。

english: to apply something; coat
primaryExample: We decided to paint the walls a lighter colour because the room receives little natural light.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定把墙刷成较浅的颜色，因为房间里的自然光很少。

english: person who works
primaryExample: Each worker received training before using the new equipment, even if they had done similar jobs before.
primaryTranslation: 每位工人在使用新设备前都接受了培训，即使以前做过类似的工作。

english: to push something against something else
primaryExample: Press the green button once the light stops flashing, and the machine will begin printing your ticket.
primaryTranslation: 指示灯停止闪烁后按绿色按钮，机器就会开始打印你的车票。

english: anything or everything needed; no matter what
primaryExample: You can choose whatever materials you need, as long as you put the unused ones away afterwards.
primaryTranslation: 你可以选择任何需要的材料，只要事后把没用的收好。

english: needed or required; unavoidable
primaryExample: It is necessary to book a place in advance because the workshop can only accommodate twelve people.
primaryTranslation: 有必要提前预约，因为这个工作坊只能容纳十二个人。

english: part of a country, of the world, area, etc.
primaryExample: The region is famous for its fruit farms, which supply fresh produce to markets across the country.
primaryTranslation: 这个地区以果园闻名，向全国各地的市场供应新鲜农产品。

english: act of growing
primaryExample: The growth of the town has increased demand for housing and put pressure on local transport services.
primaryTranslation: 城镇的发展增加了住房需求，也给当地交通服务带来了压力。

english: last part of the day and early part of the night
primaryExample: We spent the evening planning our trip, although we still could not agree on which route to take.
primaryTranslation: 我们花了一个晚上规划旅行，不过仍未能就路线达成一致。

english: to affect what happens; change something (indirectly)
primaryExample: The books we read as children can influence the way we understand the world many years later.
primaryTranslation: 童年读过的书会影响我们多年后理解世界的方式。

english: to think very highly of another person because of what they do
primaryExample: I respect her ability to stay calm when everyone else is worried about finishing the work on time.
primaryTranslation: 当其他人都担心能否按时完工时，她还能保持冷静，我敬佩她这种能力。

english: several; consisting of different things or types
primaryExample: The museum offers various activities that allow visitors to discover how people lived several hundred years ago.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆提供各种活动，让访客了解几百年前人们如何生活。

english: use your hands to stop and hold something flying
primaryExample: I managed to catch the ball before it rolled under a car parked beside the school gate.
primaryTranslation: 球滚到校门旁停着的汽车下面之前，我设法接住了它。

english: therefore; so; as a result
primaryExample: The new path avoids the main road, thus making the journey to school safer for children.
primaryTranslation: 这条新小路避开了主路，因此让孩子们上学的路程更加安全。

english: ability to do something well
primaryExample: Learning a practical skill can increase your confidence, especially when you use it to help someone else.
primaryTranslation: 学习一项实用技能可以增强信心，尤其是当你用它帮助别人的时候。

english: to try to do something challenging or difficult
primaryExample: Do not attempt to move the heavy cupboard alone, because it could damage the floor or injure you.
primaryTranslation: 不要试图独自搬动这个重柜子，因为它可能损坏地板或使你受伤。

english: male child; friendly way of addressing a boy
primaryExample: Their son chose to study in another city, although he still returns home most weekends to visit.
primaryTranslation: 他们的儿子选择去另一座城市读书，不过大多数周末仍回家探望。

english: not hard to understand or do; not complex
primaryExample: The instructions are simple enough for beginners, but the final task still requires patience and careful planning.
primaryTranslation: 说明足够简单，初学者也能懂，但最后的任务仍需要耐心和仔细规划。

english: middle size, something between other things
primaryExample: The jacket in a medium fitted my shoulders, but I needed a large to wear a thick jumper underneath.
primaryTranslation: 这件夹克中码的肩部合适，但要在里面穿厚毛衣就需要大码。

english: typical or normal; usual; ordinary
primaryExample: An average family in the area spends more on transport than families living near the city centre.
primaryTranslation: 这个地区的普通家庭花在交通上的钱比住在市中心附近的家庭多。

english: all the things that can be used or sold, usually in a store or business
primaryExample: The shop keeps extra stock during the holiday season because deliveries can take longer than usual.
primaryTranslation: 假日季节这家商店会保留额外库存，因为送货可能比平时更慢。

english: people who are in control of a business or group
primaryExample: The management agreed to change the rota after staff explained why the current arrangements were difficult.
primaryTranslation: 员工解释了现有安排的困难后，管理层同意更改轮班表。

english: your personality or nature
primaryExample: Her patient character makes her a good person to work with when a task becomes unexpectedly difficult.
primaryTranslation: 她耐心的性格让她在任务意外变难时，仍是一位很好的合作伙伴。

english: a piece of furniture that people sleep on
primaryExample: I left the book beside the bed so that I could finish reading it before going to sleep.
primaryTranslation: 我把书放在床边，以便睡前读完。

english: to fight, attack or damage something or someone
primaryExample: The ball hit the window with such force that everyone in the classroom turned towards the noise.
primaryTranslation: 球用力撞上窗户，教室里所有人都朝响声转过头。

english: to set or create something to last for a long time
primaryExample: The group hopes to establish a regular meeting place where residents can share ideas and solve local problems.
primaryTranslation: 这个团体希望建立一个固定会面场所，让居民分享想法、解决当地问题。

english: actually; in fact; in reality
primaryExample: The journey was tiring indeed, but the view from the mountain made every step feel worthwhile.
primaryTranslation: 这趟旅程的确很累，但山顶的景色让每一步都显得值得。

english: being the last thing in a series
primaryExample: The final version of the report includes several changes that were suggested during our meeting last week.
primaryTranslation: 报告的最终版本包含几处上周会议中提出的修改。

english: total of all the goods, services, and wages in an area
primaryExample: Tourism supports the local economy, but residents are concerned about the number of visitors arriving each summer.
primaryTranslation: 旅游业支撑着当地经济，但居民担心每年夏季到访的游客数量。

english: proper or acceptable; morally or socially correct
primaryExample: The old hall is no longer fit for public use because its roof needs extensive repairs.
primaryTranslation: 旧礼堂已经不适合向公众开放，因为屋顶需要大规模维修。

english: informal man; boy; any person
primaryExample: The guy at the information desk showed us a quieter route that avoided the busy shopping streets.
primaryTranslation: 咨询台那位男子给我们指了一条较安静、避开繁忙商业街的路线。

english: what something is intended to be used for; purpose
primaryExample: The main function of the roof is to keep rain out, although it also helps control temperature.
primaryTranslation: 屋顶的主要功能是挡雨，不过它也有助于调节温度。

english: day before today
primaryExample: We were planning to leave yesterday, but the storm forced us to stay for another night.
primaryTranslation: 我们原计划昨天离开，但暴风雨迫使我们多留了一晚。

english: picture, sculpture, or painting of something
primaryExample: The image on the poster shows how the town might look once the building work is complete.
primaryTranslation: 海报上的图片展示了工程完成后，这个城镇可能的样子。

english: how big or small a thing is
primaryExample: Check the size of the cupboard carefully before buying it, because the doorway is rather narrow.
primaryTranslation: 购买前请仔细检查柜子的尺寸，因为门口相当窄。

english: way a person or thing acts; manner
primaryExample: The teacher explained that respectful behavior was expected throughout the visit, especially inside the quiet exhibition rooms.
primaryTranslation: 老师解释说，参观全程都要举止有礼，尤其是在安静的展厅内。

english: fact of adding something; thing that is added
primaryExample: The addition of a small table made the kitchen a much more comfortable place to spend time.
primaryTranslation: 添了一张小桌子后，厨房成了一个舒适得多的活动空间。

english: to control exactly how something will be or act
primaryExample: The amount of space available will determine how many tables we can put in the hall safely.
primaryTranslation: 可用空间的大小将决定我们能在大厅内安全摆放多少张桌子。

english: place where you can catch a train or a bus
primaryExample: We agreed to meet outside the station, where there would be enough room for everyone to wait.
primaryTranslation: 我们约定在车站外见面，那里有足够的地方供大家等候。

english: number of people who live in a country, area, etc.
primaryExample: The population of the town has grown since a new railway line made travel to the city easier.
primaryTranslation: 新铁路线让进城更方便后，这个城镇的人口增加了。

english: to not achieve a goal, or to go wrong
primaryExample: Even careful plans can fail if people do not understand what they are expected to do.
primaryTranslation: 即使计划周密，如果人们不明白自己该做什么，计划也可能失败。

english: natural world in which plants and animals live
primaryExample: The students studied how plastic waste affects the environment before suggesting ways to reduce it at school.
primaryTranslation: 学生们先研究塑料废弃物如何影响环境，然后提出在学校减少塑料垃圾的方法。

english: process of making something on a large scale
primaryExample: The factory reduced production during the winter because fewer customers were ordering its outdoor furniture than usual.
primaryTranslation: 工厂在冬季减少了生产，因为订购户外家具的顾客比平时少。

english: legal agreement (e.g., for doing work for money)
primaryExample: Read the contract carefully before signing, especially the section that explains when either side can end the agreement.
primaryTranslation: 签字前仔细阅读合同，尤其是说明任何一方何时能终止协议的部分。

english: person who plays sports
primaryExample: Every player on the team helped defend the goal when their opponents attacked in the final minutes.
primaryTranslation: 对手在最后几分钟进攻时，队里每位球员都参与防守球门。

english: something you say; give an opinion; remark
primaryExample: Her comment about the confusing map led us to add clearer directions to the information sheet.
primaryTranslation: 她对地图难以看懂的评论，促使我们在信息表上添加了更清楚的指引。

english: to go into a room
primaryExample: Visitors must show their tickets before they enter the building, even if they have already booked online.
primaryTranslation: 访客进入大楼前必须出示门票，即使已经在线预订。

english: to come to pass or to happen
primaryExample: Small delays often occur at this station because trains from several different routes share the same platforms.
primaryTranslation: 这个车站经常出现小幅延误，因为几条不同线路的火车共用站台。

english: without anyone or anything else
primaryExample: Although she travelled alone, she met several friendly people who were following the same walking route.
primaryTranslation: 虽然她独自旅行，却结识了几位走同一条徒步路线的友好旅伴。

english: large enough to be noticed or have an effect; important
primaryExample: The new crossing has made a significant difference to families who walk to school along this road.
primaryTranslation: 新的人行横道给沿这条路步行上学的家庭带来了明显改变。

english: chemical used as a medicine
primaryExample: The leaflet explains how the drug should be stored, so the pharmacist asked her to read it carefully.
primaryTranslation: 说明书解释了这种药物该如何保存，因此药剂师让她仔细阅读。

english: high, flat side of a room or building
primaryExample: We hung the map on the wall where everyone could see it while discussing the next day's route.
primaryTranslation: 我们把地图挂在人人都能看见的墙上，讨论第二天的路线。

english: number of things that happen one after another
primaryExample: The museum is holding a series of evening talks about how the city developed over the centuries.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆正在举办一系列晚间讲座，介绍这座城市几个世纪以来的发展。

english: to tell someone to do something in a straight-talking way
primaryExample: The guide will direct visitors towards the side entrance while workers repair the steps outside the main door.
primaryTranslation: 工作人员维修正门外的台阶时，导游会引导游客走向侧门。

english: achievement of a desired purpose or goal
primaryExample: The success of the event depended on volunteers who worked quietly behind the scenes for several weeks.
primaryTranslation: 活动的成功依赖于那些连续几周在幕后默默工作的志愿者。

english: day after today
primaryExample: We will decide tomorrow whether to continue with the walk, once we have checked the latest weather forecast.
primaryTranslation: 明天查看最新天气预报后，我们将决定是否继续徒步。

english: senior person who manages part of an organization
primaryExample: The director of the museum explained why some rooms would remain closed until the repairs were complete.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆馆长解释了为什么有些房间要等维修完成后才开放。

english: in a way that is easy to understand; obviously
primaryExample: The instructions clearly state that children must be accompanied by an adult when using the climbing wall.
primaryTranslation: 说明清楚地写明，儿童使用攀岩墙时必须有成人陪同。

english: to not have, or not have enough, of something
primaryExample: Some villages lack regular bus services, which makes it difficult for residents without cars to reach the hospital.
primaryTranslation: 有些村庄缺乏固定的公交服务，使没有汽车的居民很难去医院。

english: to carefully look at the quality of something
primaryExample: We will review the arrangements after the first month to see whether the new opening hours are working well.
primaryTranslation: 第一个月结束后，我们会评估安排，看看新的开放时间效果如何。

english: to need (someone or something) for support, help, etc.
primaryExample: Whether we can hold the concert outdoors will depend on how quickly the field dries after the rain.
primaryTranslation: 音乐会能否在户外举行，将取决于雨后场地有多快干燥。

english: contest between people, animals, or vehicles, to determine which is the fastest
primaryExample: The race was postponed because strong winds made the final section of the course unsafe for runners.
primaryTranslation: 由于大风使赛道最后一段对跑者不安全，比赛延期了。

english: to remember because you have met it before
primaryExample: I did not recognize my old classmate at first because we had not seen each other for years.
primaryTranslation: 我起初没有认出老同学，因为我们已多年未见。

english: opening in a wall or door to let in light
primaryExample: We opened the window slightly so that fresh air could enter without making the classroom too cold.
primaryTranslation: 我们把窗户稍微打开，让新鲜空气进来，同时不让教室太冷。

english: reason for which something is done; aim; goal
primaryExample: The purpose of the meeting is to hear residents' concerns before the council makes its final decision.
primaryTranslation: 会议的目的是在市政委员会做出最终决定前，听取居民的担忧。

english: division of a larger part or organization
primaryExample: The science department has borrowed equipment from a nearby college so that students can try more experiments.
primaryTranslation: 科学系向附近一所学院借了设备，让学生能尝试更多实验。

english: (v) to get (n) something wanted, needed, or valued
primaryExample: Volunteering at the centre helped her gain experience that later proved useful when she applied for work.
primaryTranslation: 在中心做志愿服务帮助她积累了经验，后来申请工作时证明这些经验很有用。

english: tall green plants in a forest
primaryExample: The tree outside our kitchen window provides shade in summer, but its leaves block the gutter every autumn.
primaryTranslation: 厨房窗外的树在夏天提供荫凉，但每到秋天树叶就会堵住排水槽。

english: school or educational institution for adults
primaryExample: She chose a college close to home because it offered the practical course she wanted to study.
primaryTranslation: 她选了一所离家近的学院，因为那里有她想读的实践课程。

english: to give reasons for or against an idea or point of view
primaryExample: Some residents argue that the new playground should include equipment suitable for older children as well.
primaryTranslation: 一些居民主张，新游乐场还应配备适合年龄较大孩子的设施。

english: surface for posting or showing information
primaryExample: The notice on the board explains which rooms are available and who to contact about booking them.
primaryTranslation: 公告板上的通知说明了哪些房间可用，以及预订时该联系谁。

english: day when people don't go to work or school
primaryExample: We are planning a holiday in the mountains, where we can walk without using the car every day.
primaryTranslation: 我们计划去山里度假，那里可以徒步，不必每天开车。

english: to make or leave a visible sign on something; a writing symbol
primaryExample: Please mark any errors you find in pencil so that the writer can correct them before printing.
primaryTranslation: 请用铅笔标出发现的错误，方便作者在打印前改正。

english: building where religious people gather and pray
primaryExample: The old church is open to visitors on weekdays, although services take place there every Sunday morning.
primaryTranslation: 这座老教堂工作日对游客开放，不过每周日早晨那里都会举行礼拜。

english: piece of equipment used to do work
primaryExample: The machine stops automatically if the cover is opened, which prevents people from touching the moving parts.
primaryTranslation: 如果盖子被打开，机器就会自动停止，以防人们触碰活动部件。

english: to succeed in doing something good, usually by working hard
primaryExample: She worked steadily towards her goal and managed to achieve it earlier than anyone had expected.
primaryTranslation: 她稳步朝目标努力，设法比所有人预想的更早实现了它。

english: distinct, individual thing, often part of a group
primaryExample: Each item on the list must be checked before the boxes are loaded onto the delivery van.
primaryTranslation: 在把箱子装上送货车前，清单上的每件物品都必须核对。

english: to demonstrate truth by providing evidence
primaryExample: The experiment helped prove that the amount of light affected how quickly the young plants grew.
primaryTranslation: 这次实验有助于证明，光照量影响了幼苗的生长速度。

english: 100th of the basic unit of money (e.g., there are 100 of these in a dollar)
primaryExample: The children saved every cent they earned because they wanted to buy equipment for their school garden.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们把挣来的每一分钱都存起来，因为他们想为学校花园买工具。

english: one of the four parts of the year determined mainly by the weather during that time
primaryExample: Spring is the best season to visit the valley because the paths are quiet and the flowers are blooming.
primaryTranslation: 春季是游览山谷的最佳季节，因为小路安静，鲜花盛开。

english: part of a room on which you stand
primaryExample: We covered the floor before painting the ceiling so that any falling paint would not damage the wood.
primaryTranslation: 刷天花板前，我们盖住地板，防止滴落的油漆损坏木材。

english: generic description for things, materials, objects
primaryExample: We packed all the camping stuff into the car before checking whether there was room for our bags.
primaryTranslation: 我们把所有露营用品装进车里后，才检查行李包是否还有地方放。

english: having a great distance from one side to the other
primaryExample: The doorway is wide enough for a wheelchair, although the short ramp outside still needs repairing.
primaryTranslation: 门口足够宽，能让轮椅通过，不过外面那段短坡道仍需维修。

english: any person
primaryExample: If anyone needs help with the application, a volunteer will be available at the library this afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 如果有人需要填写申请方面的帮助，今天下午图书馆会有一名志愿者提供协助。

english: organized and planned way of doing something
primaryExample: The teacher demonstrated a method for checking calculations that did not require us to use a calculator.
primaryTranslation: 老师演示了一种不需要计算器的计算结果检查方法。

english: careful study to better understand something
primaryExample: Our analysis of the survey showed that most visitors wanted more information about the walking routes.
primaryTranslation: 我们对调查的分析表明，大多数游客希望得到更多步行路线信息。

english: process of choosing someone by voting
primaryExample: Candidates visited local schools before the election to explain how they would improve services for young people.
primaryTranslation: 选举前，候选人走访当地学校，说明他们将如何改善面向年轻人的服务。

english: concerning soldiers or the armed forces
primaryExample: The museum explains how the military helped build roads that later became important routes for local trade.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆解释了军队如何帮助修建道路，而这些道路后来成了当地贸易的重要路线。

english: place where people can stay when traveling
primaryExample: We chose a hotel near the station so that we would not need a taxi after arriving late.
primaryTranslation: 我们选了车站附近的酒店，以便晚到时不必叫出租车。

english: group of people who share an interest, as in sport
primaryExample: The club welcomes beginners and provides equipment for people who want to try the sport before buying their own.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部欢迎初学者，并为想先尝试运动再购买自用器材的人提供设备。

english: in a lower position, place, or level
primaryExample: The temperature dropped below freezing during the night, so the paths were still icy in the morning.
primaryTranslation: 夜间气温降到冰点以下，所以早晨小路上仍然结着冰。

english: motion picture; film
primaryExample: The movie follows a family who move to a new country and gradually learn to feel at home.
primaryTranslation: 这部电影讲述一个家庭移居异国并逐渐找到归属感的故事。

english: a professional who is trained and licensed to treat sick or injured people; a person who has the highest degree given by a university
primaryExample: The doctor asked several questions about her daily routine before suggesting that she keep a sleep diary.
primaryTranslation: 医生问了几个关于她日常作息的问题，然后建议她记录睡眠日记。

english: any long communication about some particular topic
primaryExample: The discussion became more useful once everyone had a chance to describe the problems they were facing.
primaryTranslation: 每个人都有机会描述自己面临的问题之后，讨论变得更有帮助了。

english: what you say to admit you were wrong
primaryExample: I am sorry that we kept you waiting, but the earlier meeting took longer than we expected.
primaryTranslation: 很抱歉让你久等了，但之前的会议比我们预计的更长。

english: an activity you wish to try that may be hard to do
primaryExample: Designing a bridge from paper was a challenge that encouraged the students to test several different ideas.
primaryTranslation: 用纸设计一座桥是一项挑战，鼓励了学生们测试多种不同想法。

english: area or region controlled by a government and army
primaryExample: The festival brings together performers from across the nation to celebrate music that is rarely heard elsewhere.
primaryTranslation: 这个节日汇聚了全国的表演者，庆祝在其他地方很少听到的音乐。

english: not completely; almost
primaryExample: We had nearly finished packing when we discovered that one of the bags was too heavy to carry.
primaryTranslation: 我们快打包完时，才发现其中一个包重得搬不动。

english: act or process of saying something formally
primaryExample: The council released a statement explaining why the bridge would remain closed until engineers completed their checks.
primaryTranslation: 市政委员会发表声明，解释为什么桥梁要等工程师完成检查后才会开放。

english: to join or connect together
primaryExample: The new cycle path will link the station to the park, making the journey easier for local families.
primaryTranslation: 新自行车道将连接车站和公园，让当地家庭出行更方便。

english: without being affected by something; in spite of
primaryExample: Despite the heavy rain, the volunteers arrived on time and helped move the equipment into the hall.
primaryTranslation: 尽管下着大雨，志愿者们仍准时赶到，帮忙把设备搬进大厅。

english: to make someone known to another by name
primaryExample: Before we begin the workshop, I would like to introduce the people who will be helping us today.
primaryTranslation: 在工作坊开始前，我想介绍一下今天将协助我们的几位工作人员。

english: thing making the chance of success higher
primaryExample: One advantage of living near the station is that we can reach the city without driving.
primaryTranslation: 住在车站附近的一个好处是，我们不开车也能进城。

english: prepared to do something
primaryExample: Please have your tickets ready before you reach the entrance, so that everyone can get inside quickly.
primaryTranslation: 到达入口前请准备好门票，方便大家快速入场。

english: to become the husband or wife of someone
primaryExample: They decided to marry in the village where they first met, although neither of them lived there anymore.
primaryTranslation: 他们决定在初次见面的村庄结婚，尽管两人都已不再住在那里。

english: to hit something
primaryExample: A loose branch could strike the window during the storm, so we moved the table away from the glass.
primaryTranslation: 暴风雨中，一根松动的树枝可能撞上窗户，所以我们把桌子移离了玻璃。

english: unit of distance; 1.6 kilometers
primaryExample: The nearest shop is over a mile away, so we usually buy everything we need in one visit.
primaryTranslation: 最近的商店有一英里多远，所以我们通常一次买齐所需物品。

english: to search for; to try to find; look for
primaryExample: The organisers will seek advice from local residents before deciding where the new playground should be built.
primaryTranslation: 组织者将在决定新游乐场建在哪里之前，向当地居民征求意见。

english: power, money, knowledge, or skill to do something
primaryExample: Her ability to explain complicated ideas clearly made the training session useful for people with little experience.
primaryTranslation: 她能清楚解释复杂概念，这让经验不多的人也能从培训中受益。

english: single thing or person; a part of something larger
primaryExample: Each unit in the course builds on the previous one, so it is worth completing them in order.
primaryTranslation: 课程的每个单元都建立在前一个单元的基础上，因此值得按顺序完成。

english: small piece of paper or plastic used as i.d.
primaryExample: You must show your membership card at the desk before borrowing equipment from the sports centre.
primaryTranslation: 在体育中心借用器材前，你必须在服务台出示会员卡。

english: building for sick people, with doctors and nurses
primaryExample: The hospital opened a new entrance so that visitors could reach the children's ward more easily.
primaryTranslation: 这家医院开设了一个新入口，让访客能更容易到达儿科病房。

english: without taking a lot of time; fast
primaryExample: We moved the chairs quickly when the rain started, but managed to keep most of the cushions dry.
primaryTranslation: 下雨时我们迅速搬走了椅子，设法让大多数坐垫没有淋湿。

english: to formally ask questions about a given topic
primaryExample: The students will interview older residents to discover how the town has changed since they were young.
primaryTranslation: 学生们将采访年长居民，了解这个城镇自他们年轻时起发生了哪些变化。

english: when you share the same opinion or reach a decision
primaryExample: We reached an agreement on the route after everyone explained which places they most wanted to visit.
primaryTranslation: 每个人说明自己最想游览哪些地方后，我们就路线达成了一致。

english: to allow to leave jail, cage, prison, etc.
primaryExample: The rescue centre will release the bird once its wing has healed and it can fly safely again.
primaryTranslation: 等鸟的翅膀痊愈、能够再次安全飞行后，救助中心就会放归它。

english: money taken by a government from its people
primaryExample: The price on the label includes tax, so you will not pay anything extra at the checkout.
primaryTranslation: 标签上的价格含税，所以结账时不用再额外支付。

english: something that ends a problem
primaryExample: We found a solution that allowed both groups to use the hall without changing their regular meeting times.
primaryTranslation: 我们找到一个解决办法，让两个小组都能使用大厅，而不用改变各自固定的会面时间。

chinese: 首都的；主要的；极重要的
english: main, or major
primaryExample: The capital city attracts visitors throughout the year, although many prefer to explore its quieter neighbourhoods in spring.
primaryTranslation: 这座首都全年都吸引着游客，不过许多人更喜欢在春天探索其较安静的街区。

english: liked or enjoyed by many people
primaryExample: The cafe has become popular with students because it provides quiet tables and stays open until late.
primaryTranslation: 这家咖啡馆提供安静的桌位并营业至深夜，因此很受学生欢迎。

english: special or particular; clearly presented or stated
primaryExample: Please give a specific example when you explain the problem, so that we know what needs changing.
primaryTranslation: 解释问题时请举出具体例子，以便我们知道需要改变什么。

english: having very attractive or appealing physical qualities
primaryExample: The garden is especially beautiful in early spring, when flowers appear beneath the trees beside the lake.
primaryTranslation: 早春时，湖边树下开出鲜花，花园格外美丽。

english: unpleasant feeling caused by being aware of danger
primaryExample: Her fear of deep water gradually decreased after she practised swimming with an instructor she trusted.
primaryTranslation: 她跟随信任的教练练习游泳后，对深水的恐惧逐渐减轻了。

english: act of pointing something at a target
primaryExample: His aim improved after the coach showed him how to hold the bow without moving his shoulders.
primaryTranslation: 教练教他如何在不移动肩膀的情况下持弓后，他瞄得更准了。

english: device that broadcasts programs, movies, or show
primaryExample: We turned off the television during dinner so that everyone could talk about what had happened that day.
primaryTranslation: 吃晚饭时我们关掉电视，让大家都能聊聊当天发生的事。

english: needing thought or concentration; important; in a sober manner
primaryExample: The shortage of water became a serious problem after the region went several weeks without rain.
primaryTranslation: 这个地区连续数周没有下雨后，缺水成了一个严重问题。

english: a goal or amount you are trying to achieve
primaryExample: The team reached its target earlier than expected, so it decided to spend more time checking the quality.
primaryTranslation: 团队比预期更早达到目标，于是决定花更多时间检查质量。

english: unit for measuring temperature or angles
primaryExample: Even a difference of one degree can affect the results, so we checked the thermometer before each test.
primaryTranslation: 即使相差一度也会影响结果，所以每次测试前我们都检查温度计。

english: to hold something and move it toward you
primaryExample: Pull the handle gently towards you until the door opens, then keep it clear of the passing trolley.
primaryTranslation: 把手柄轻轻拉向自己，直到门打开，然后别让门挡住经过的手推车。

english: being the color of blood
primaryExample: She tied a red ribbon around her suitcase handle so that she could recognize it at the airport.
primaryTranslation: 她在行李箱把手上系了一条红丝带，以便在机场认出它。

english: married man
primaryExample: Her husband offered to collect the children so that she could stay and finish the training session.
primaryTranslation: 她丈夫主动提出去接孩子，让她能留下来完成培训。

english: an entrance to a place; a way in
primaryExample: The building has step-free access at the side, which makes it easier for visitors using wheelchairs.
primaryTranslation: 建筑侧面设有无台阶通道，方便使用轮椅的访客。

english: a change in the position of something
primaryExample: The camera detects movement near the entrance and switches on a light when someone approaches after dark.
primaryTranslation: 摄像头检测入口附近的移动，天黑后有人靠近时就会开灯。

english: to act in a certain way toward someone
primaryExample: We should treat new members kindly, especially when they are unsure how the group usually works.
primaryTranslation: 我们应该友善地对待新成员，尤其是在他们还不熟悉团队惯例时。

english: to indicate who or what someone or something is
primaryExample: The labels help visitors identify the plants, even when the flowers that usually make them recognizable have disappeared.
primaryTranslation: 标签帮助游客辨认植物，即使那些通常用于识别的花朵已经凋谢。

primaryCollocations.chinese: 根据名字确认某人身份

english: experience or state of failing to have or keep
primaryExample: The loss of the old playground upset families who had used it regularly for many years.
primaryTranslation: 失去旧游乐场让多年来经常在那里活动的家庭感到难过。

english: expressing the future tense, to expect to happen
primaryExample: We shall send you the final details once the venue has confirmed how many people it can accommodate.
primaryTranslation: 场地确认可以容纳多少人之后，我们将把最终详情发送给你。

english: of the present time; up to date; contemporary
primaryExample: The museum combines a modern entrance with the original building, allowing easier access without hiding its history.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆将现代入口与原有建筑结合，让出入更方便，同时保留其历史特色。

english: force/weight when pressing against a thing
primaryExample: The pressure inside the tyre was too low, so we stopped to put more air into it.
primaryTranslation: 轮胎内的气压太低，因此我们停下来补气。

english: a large road vehicle used for carrying many people
primaryExample: We caught an earlier bus because the next service would not arrive until after the museum opened.
primaryTranslation: 我们乘了更早的一班公交车，因为下一班要在博物馆开门后才到。

english: way someone acts toward another
primaryExample: Her treatment of the new volunteers made them feel welcome, even though they had little experience.
primaryTranslation: 她对待新志愿者的方式让他们感到受欢迎，尽管他们没什么经验。

english: an event where people exchange ideas
primaryExample: The conference brought together teachers from different countries to discuss ways of making science lessons more practical.
primaryTranslation: 这次会议汇聚了来自不同国家的教师，讨论如何让科学课更注重实践。

english: reflexive form of 'you', used for an emphasis
primaryExample: You can try the activity yourself after watching the demonstration, but ask for help if anything feels unsafe.
primaryTranslation: 看过演示后，你可以自己试试这个活动，但如果觉得哪里不安全，请寻求帮助。

english: to give or sell goods to others for their use
primaryExample: Local farms supply fresh vegetables to the school, which helps children learn where their food comes from.
primaryTranslation: 当地农场给学校供应新鲜蔬菜，帮助孩子们了解食物来自哪里。

english: small town in the country
primaryExample: The village has only one shop, but a regular bus connects it with the nearest town.
primaryTranslation: 这个村庄只有一家商店，不过有固定公交连接最近的城镇。

english: the value of something in money or effort
primaryExample: She brought several days' worth of food because the nearest shop would be too far away.
primaryTranslation: 她带了够吃几天的食物，因为最近的商店实在太远。

english: not made by humans; without human intervention
primaryExample: The path follows the natural shape of the valley, rather than cutting directly through the forest.
primaryTranslation: 这条小路顺着山谷的天然地形延伸，而不是直接穿过森林。

english: to state or show what you think or how you feel
primaryExample: She used a letter to express her thanks because she wanted the volunteers to know how much their help mattered.
primaryTranslation: 她用信表达谢意，因为想让志愿者知道他们的帮助有多重要。

english: to show something, direct attention to, or point out
primaryExample: The arrows indicate which way visitors should walk, helping to prevent crowds from blocking the narrow entrance.
primaryTranslation: 箭头指明游客应往哪边走，有助于防止人群堵住狭窄入口。

english: to be present at an event
primaryExample: If you cannot attend the meeting in person, you can still share your suggestions by email beforehand.
primaryTranslation: 如果无法亲自出席会议，你仍然可以提前通过电子邮件分享建议。

english: a boy or man who shares a parent with you
primaryExample: My brother offered to repair the bicycle after noticing that I was having trouble changing the gears.
primaryTranslation: 哥哥注意到我换挡有困难后，主动提出帮我修自行车。

english: something purchased hoping its value will increase
primaryExample: The new equipment was a considerable investment, but the cafe hoped it would reduce waste over time.
primaryTranslation: 新设备是一笔可观的投资，不过咖啡馆希望它能逐渐减少浪费。

english: to get points in a sport such as kicking a ball into a goal
primaryExample: Our team failed to score until the final minute, when a substitute finally found space near the goal.
primaryTranslation: 我们队直到最后一分钟才得分，当时一名替补终于在球门附近找到空当。

english: to arrange and plan things (e.g., a party)
primaryExample: We need to organize the equipment before the workshop starts, so that each group has everything it needs.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊开始前，我们需要整理器材，让每组都有所需物品。

english: going from one place to another for fun or business
primaryExample: The trip gave the students a chance to see how the ideas from their lessons worked in practice.
primaryTranslation: 这次旅行让学生有机会看到课堂中的知识如何在实践中运用。

english: on or to the farther side; in addition to
primaryExample: Beyond the village, the road becomes narrower and passes through fields where visitors rarely stop to explore.
primaryTranslation: 过了村庄，道路变窄，穿过游客很少驻足探索的田野。

english: to rest your body in bed, as at night time
primaryExample: I find it easier to sleep when the room is cool and there is no light from screens.
primaryTranslation: 房间凉爽、没有屏幕亮光时，我发现自己更容易入睡。

english: animal that swims and lives in the sea
primaryExample: We saw a silver fish near the bank, where the water was clear enough to reveal the stones below.
primaryTranslation: 我们在岸边看见了一条银色的鱼，那里的水清得能看见底下的石头。

english: to say you will certainly do something
primaryExample: Please do not promise to finish by Friday unless you are sure the materials will arrive in time.
primaryTranslation: 除非你确定材料会及时送达，否则请不要承诺周五前完成。

english: capable of happening or becoming reality
primaryExample: The plan offers potential benefits for local businesses, although residents are concerned about the extra traffic.
primaryTranslation: 这项计划可能给当地企业带来好处，不过居民担心增加的交通量。

english: physical or mental strength
primaryExample: After a busy week at work, I rarely have the energy to cook a complicated meal on Friday evening.
primaryTranslation: 忙碌地工作一周后，周五晚上我很少有精力做复杂的饭菜。

english: (v) to cause (n) difficulty, worry, or bother to someone
primaryExample: We had trouble finding the entrance because the sign was hidden behind a large delivery van.
primaryTranslation: 我们很难找到入口，因为标牌被一辆大型送货车挡住了。

english: manner in which people, groups, or countries behave toward one another
primaryExample: The relation between the two groups improved after they began working together on the village garden.
primaryTranslation: 两个团体开始合作打理村庄花园之后，彼此关系改善了。

english: to feel an object with your fingers, etc.
primaryExample: Do not touch the painted surface until it is completely dry, even if it looks ready.
primaryTranslation: 即使表面看起来已经好了，在油漆完全干燥前也不要触摸。

english: to submit documents to an authority (e.g., city hall)
primaryExample: You must file the application before the closing date if you want the council to consider your request.
primaryTranslation: 如果希望市政委员会考虑你的请求，就必须在截止日期前提交申请。

english: place that is halfway between two things
primaryExample: We stopped in the middle of the bridge to look at the boats passing slowly beneath us.
primaryTranslation: 我们停在桥中间，看着船只在脚下缓缓驶过。

english: to prevent entry, exit, or an action
primaryExample: The rules bar visitors from entering the work area unless a member of staff is accompanying them.
primaryTranslation: 规则禁止游客进入作业区，除非有工作人员陪同。

english: to experience pain, illness, or injury
primaryExample: People may suffer from tiredness when their working hours change suddenly and they cannot maintain a regular routine.
primaryTranslation: 工时突然改变、无法保持规律作息时，人们可能会感到疲倦。

english: careful plan or method for achieving a goal
primaryExample: Our strategy was to finish the most difficult tasks first, leaving simpler work for the final afternoon.
primaryTranslation: 我们的策略是先完成最难的任务，把较简单的工作留到最后一天下午。

english: going far down from the surface
primaryExample: The lake is too deep near the old bridge, so swimming is only allowed in the marked area.
primaryTranslation: 老桥附近的湖水太深，所以只能在指定区域游泳。

chinese: 除...之外（用于所言不包括的人或事物前）
english: not including; other than
primaryExample: Everyone except my sister joined the morning walk, because she had already arranged to meet a friend.
primaryTranslation: 除了我姐姐，所有人都参加了早晨的徒步，因为她已约好去见朋友。
