english: being free from dirt or marks because it was washed
primaryExample: The kitchen looked clean when we arrived, but we still washed the surfaces before preparing any food.
primaryTranslation: 我们到达时厨房看起来很干净，但准备食物前还是擦洗了台面。

english: to regularly behave in a certain way
primaryExample: Children tend to ask more questions when they can touch the objects being discussed in the lesson.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们能触摸课堂上讨论的物品时，往往会提出更多问题。

english: to move forward in a certain direction
primaryExample: The group could not advance beyond the bridge until the guide had checked that the path was safe.
primaryTranslation: 向导确认小路安全之前，这个团队无法继续前进越过桥梁。

english: to make something full
primaryExample: Please fill the bottle before we leave the campsite, because there may be no water along the route.
primaryTranslation: 离开营地前，请把水瓶装满，因为沿途可能没有水。

english: a bright planet of gas in the night sky
primaryExample: The guide pointed out a bright star that sailors once used to help them find their direction.
primaryTranslation: 导游指给我们看一颗亮星，水手们曾靠它来判断方向。

english: system of connections
primaryExample: The town has a network of paths that connects the school, library and park without crossing busy roads.
primaryTranslation: 镇上有一套步道网络，连接学校、图书馆和公园，无需穿越繁忙道路。

english: usually; as a rule; by, to, or for most people
primaryExample: The route is generally quiet in the morning, although it becomes much busier when the weekend market opens.
primaryTranslation: 这条路线早晨通常很安静，不过周末市场开门时就热闹得多。

english: functioning; use
primaryExample: The operation of the new heating system is simple once you understand how to set the timer.
primaryTranslation: 一旦弄清楚如何设定定时器，这套新供暖系统的操作就很简单。

english: a sports competition between two people or teams
primaryExample: The match was delayed by heavy rain, so the players waited inside until the pitch was safe.
primaryTranslation: 比赛因大雨推迟，所以队员们在室内等待，直到场地恢复安全。

english: to prevent from happening, or stay away from
primaryExample: We left the main path to avoid the crowds, but soon discovered that the quieter route was much steeper.
primaryTranslation: 我们离开主路避开人群，却很快发现较安静的路线陡得多。

english: something on which a person can sit
primaryExample: I offered my seat to a passenger who was carrying a baby and several heavy shopping bags.
primaryTranslation: 我把座位让给了一位抱着婴儿、提着几个沉重购物袋的乘客。

english: to use your arm to make a thing fly through the air
primaryExample: Try to throw the ball gently enough for the younger children to catch it without moving too far.
primaryTranslation: 尽量轻轻地扔球，让较小的孩子不用移动太远也能接住。

english: big or small piece of work someone has to do
primaryExample: The task became easier once we divided it into smaller parts and agreed who would do each one.
primaryTranslation: 我们把任务拆成小部分，并商定各自负责哪一部分后，任务变容易了。

english: standard or regular way of doing something
primaryExample: It is normal to feel nervous before speaking to a new group, even if you know the subject well.
primaryTranslation: 即使你很熟悉主题，在新群体面前讲话前感到紧张也很正常。

english: something you try to do or achieve; an aim
primaryExample: Her main goal was to finish the course, but she also hoped to make a few new friends.
primaryTranslation: 她的主要目标是完成课程，不过也希望交几个新朋友。

english: partner in professional work (e.g., in law)
primaryExample: Her business associate offered to handle the orders while she travelled abroad to meet a new supplier.
primaryTranslation: 她的商业伙伴提出，在她出国会见新供应商期间负责处理订单。

english: color of the clear sky
primaryExample: The bright blue walls made the room feel cheerful, even when the sky outside was grey.
primaryTranslation: 鲜蓝色的墙壁让房间显得很欢快，即使外面的天空灰蒙蒙的。

english: good or useful in qualities, constructive, confident
primaryExample: The teacher gave positive feedback that helped the students understand what they had done well in the project.
primaryTranslation: 老师给了积极反馈，帮助学生明白自己在项目中哪些方面做得好。

english: possibility out of several that can be chosen; choice
primaryExample: Taking the train is the cheapest option, although the bus stops much closer to our final destination.
primaryTranslation: 坐火车是最便宜的选择，不过公交站离我们的最终目的地近得多。

english: a container with (usually) four straight sides and a lid
primaryExample: We put the photographs in a strong box so that they would not get damaged during the move.
primaryTranslation: 我们把照片放进一个结实的盒子，防止搬家时损坏。

english: very very large
primaryExample: The new library has made a huge difference to families who previously had nowhere nearby to borrow books.
primaryTranslation: 新图书馆给以前在附近无处借书的家庭带来了巨大改变。

english: piece of information that is sent from to a person
primaryExample: I left a message explaining where we had gone, in case the others arrived before we returned.
primaryTranslation: 我留了言，说明我们去了哪里，以防其他人在我们回来前到达。

english: one of a particular group given as an example
primaryExample: There are several ways to reduce waste; for instance, you can repair things instead of replacing them.
primaryTranslation: 减少浪费有几种方法；例如，你可以修理物品，而不是换新的。

english: the particular way something is done or made
primaryExample: The restaurant's relaxed style makes it popular with families who want a meal without too much formality.
primaryTranslation: 这家餐馆轻松的风格，让想自在吃顿饭的家庭很喜欢。

english: to talk about or write about something
primaryExample: The article does not refer to any particular school, although its findings may be useful to many teachers.
primaryTranslation: 这篇文章没有提到任何特定学校，不过研究结果可能对许多教师有用。

english: having a very low temperature
primaryExample: The water was too cold for a long swim, so we stayed near the shore and returned quickly.
primaryTranslation: 水太冷，不适合长时间游泳，所以我们待在岸边附近，很快就回来了。

english: to force something away from you
primaryExample: You will need to push the door firmly because the wind is pressing against it from outside.
primaryTranslation: 你需要用力推门，因为外面的风正顶着门。

english: one of four equal parts of something
primaryExample: Only a quarter of the group had visited the museum before, so the guide began with a general introduction.
primaryTranslation: 团队中只有四分之一的人以前参观过博物馆，所以导游先作了概括介绍。

english: to believe, based on the evidence; suppose
primaryExample: Do not assume that every visitor knows the building, because some people may be coming here for the first time.
primaryTranslation: 不要以为每位访客都熟悉这栋楼，因为有些人可能是第一次来。

english: very young child, who cannot yet speak
primaryExample: The baby fell asleep during the journey, so we spoke quietly when we finally reached the hotel.
primaryTranslation: 婴儿在路上睡着了，所以终于到酒店时，我们说话很轻。

english: having the desired effect or result
primaryExample: The event was successful because local residents helped plan activities that people of different ages could enjoy.
primaryTranslation: 这次活动很成功，因为当地居民帮助策划了适合不同年龄人群的活动。

english: to make musical sounds with your voice
primaryExample: The children began to sing as they walked, which made the final part of the journey feel shorter.
primaryTranslation: 孩子们边走边唱，让旅程最后一段感觉没那么长了。

english: not being sure of something; lack of certainty
primaryExample: There was some doubt about the date, so we checked the invitation before booking our train tickets.
primaryTranslation: 日期有些不确定，所以我们订火车票前核对了邀请函。

english: fighting against others when trying to win something
primaryExample: The competition attracted young designers who were asked to create useful objects from materials that would otherwise be thrown away.
primaryTranslation: 这场比赛吸引了年轻设计师，要求他们用原本会被丢弃的材料设计实用物品。

english: idea or set of ideas that try to explain facts or events
primaryExample: The theory seemed convincing, but we needed an experiment to find out whether it matched what actually happened.
primaryTranslation: 这个理论似乎很有说服力，但我们需要实验来判断它是否符合实际情况。

english: to offer or put forward an idea for consideration
primaryExample: I propose that we try the new timetable for a month before deciding whether to keep it permanently.
primaryTranslation: 我建议先试行新时间表一个月，再决定是否永久保留。

english: to cite a piece of research in speech or in writing
primaryExample: Remember to reference the original report whenever you use its figures, so that readers can check the source themselves.
primaryTranslation: 使用原报告中的数字时，记得注明出处，方便读者自行核查来源。

english: a discussion in which you disagree with another's opinion
primaryExample: Their argument about the route ended when they checked the map and discovered that both roads reached the lake.
primaryTranslation: 他们查看地图、发现两条路都通往湖泊后，就不再为路线争论了。

english: person or animal that is fully grown
primaryExample: Every adult accompanying the group received a copy of the plan and a list of emergency contact numbers.
primaryTranslation: 每位随团成人都领到了一份计划和紧急联系电话表。

english: to travel through the air using wings
primaryExample: The birds fly south when the weather becomes colder, returning only when there is enough food again.
primaryTranslation: 天气变冷时，这些鸟飞往南方，直到食物再次充足才会返回。

english: official (printed) record that gives information
primaryExample: Keep a copy of the document somewhere safe, in case the original is lost during the move.
primaryTranslation: 请把文件副本妥善保存，以防原件在搬家时丢失。

english: a series of actions or designs that can be repeated
primaryExample: We noticed a pattern in the answers, although we needed more information before we could explain it.
primaryTranslation: 我们在答案中发现了一种规律，不过还需要更多信息才能解释。

english: formal request for a job, building permission, etc.
primaryExample: Your application should explain why you want to join the course and what you hope to learn.
primaryTranslation: 你的申请应说明为什么想参加课程，以及希望学到什么。

english: having a high temperature
primaryExample: The classroom became so hot in the afternoon that we moved our discussion to a shaded area outside.
primaryTranslation: 下午教室变得很热，于是我们把讨论移到了外面的阴凉处。

english: in a way that is easy to see or understand
primaryExample: The instructions were obviously confusing, because several groups made the same mistake despite reading them carefully twice.
primaryTranslation: 说明显然令人困惑，因为几个小组仔细读了两遍，还是犯了同样的错误。

english: not easy to understand; not obvious
primaryExample: The reason for the delay remains unclear, although the company has promised to provide more information tomorrow.
primaryTranslation: 延误原因仍不清楚，不过公司承诺明天提供更多信息。

english: a piece of paper showing what you have to pay
primaryExample: We checked the bill carefully because it included a dish that nobody at our table had ordered.
primaryTranslation: 我们仔细核对了账单，因为上面有一道我们这一桌无人点过的菜。

english: to carefully look for something
primaryExample: We decided to search the garden first because that was where the children had last seen the kitten.
primaryTranslation: 我们决定先搜寻花园，因为孩子们最后一次见到小猫就是在那里。

english: to divide into parts, or to make something divide into parts
primaryExample: Please separate the broken pieces from the rest of the equipment so that nobody uses them by mistake.
primaryTranslation: 请把损坏的部件与其他设备分开，免得有人误用。

english: being in the middle
primaryExample: The central courtyard provides a quiet place to sit, even though busy classrooms surround it on every side.
primaryTranslation: 中央庭院四面被忙碌的教室环绕，但仍提供了安静的休息场所。

english: a particular occupation in professional life
primaryExample: She changed her career after discovering that she enjoyed teaching practical skills more than working in an office.
primaryTranslation: 她发现自己比起办公室工作更喜欢教授实践技能，于是换了职业。

english: a word people use to change the topic of a conversation
primaryExample: We had almost forgotten about the delayed parcel; anyway, what time are we meeting at the station tomorrow?
primaryTranslation: 我们差不多忘了那个延误的包裹；对了，我们明天几点在车站见面？

english: expression of ideas or opinions
primaryExample: She prepared a short speech to thank the volunteers who had worked so hard to restore the garden.
primaryTranslation: 她准备了一篇简短讲话，感谢那些为恢复花园而辛勤工作的志愿者。

english: an animal with four legs that is used for hunting, guarding, or as a pet.
primaryExample: The dog waited by the gate until its owner returned from collecting the children at the nearby school.
primaryTranslation: 狗在门边等待，直到主人从附近学校接孩子回来。

english: a person with an important position in an organization
primaryExample: The safety officer checked the hall before the concert to make sure that all the exits were clear.
primaryTranslation: 演唱会前，安全负责人检查了大厅，确保所有出口畅通。

english: over or across an entire thing or place, or in every part of something
primaryExample: The volunteers remained cheerful throughout the afternoon, even when the rain made their outdoor work more difficult.
primaryTranslation: 整个下午，志愿者们都很愉快，即使下雨让户外工作更困难。

english: thick, black liquid in the ground used as fuel
primaryExample: The museum explains how oil is taken from deep underground before it is processed into different fuels.
primaryTranslation: 博物馆介绍了石油如何从地下深处被开采出来，再加工成不同燃料。

english: women's garment with a top part and a skirt
primaryExample: She wore a dress that her grandmother had made, adding a jacket when the evening grew cooler.
primaryTranslation: 她穿了一条祖母做的连衣裙，傍晚天气转凉时又加了件夹克。

english: to earn money from something
primaryExample: Local businesses may profit from the festival because visitors often stay overnight and spend money in nearby shops.
primaryTranslation: 当地商家可能从节庆中获利，因为游客往往会留宿，并在附近商店消费。

english: to give an answer without knowing if it is correct
primaryExample: I could only guess how long the journey would take, because I had never used that route before.
primaryTranslation: 我只能猜测路程要多久，因为以前从未走过那条路线。

english: (n) activity that is (adj) amusing and enjoyable
primaryExample: The workshop was a fun way to learn about science, especially because we could try the experiments ourselves.
primaryTranslation: 工作坊是一种有趣的科学学习方式，尤其是我们可以亲自尝试实验。

english: to defend someone or something from harm or danger
primaryExample: We planted a row of trees to protect the young vegetables from the strong winds crossing the field.
primaryTranslation: 我们种了一排树，保护幼嫩蔬菜免受穿过田野的强风侵袭。

english: essential supply of something
primaryExample: The library is a valuable resource for students who need reliable information but cannot afford to buy every book.
primaryTranslation: 对于需要可靠信息却买不起所有书籍的学生来说，图书馆是一项宝贵资源。

english: knowledge of the physical world based on facts
primaryExample: Her interest in science grew when she began asking why the plants in different parts of the garden grew differently.
primaryTranslation: 她开始追问为什么花园不同位置的植物生长不同后，对科学的兴趣增加了。

english: illness that affects a person, animal, or plant
primaryExample: Scientists study how the disease spreads between plants so that farmers can protect the rest of their crops.
primaryTranslation: 科学家研究这种疾病如何在植物间传播，以帮助农民保护其余作物。

english: to make two or more things equal
primaryExample: She tries to balance work and family life by keeping her evenings free whenever the schedule allows.
primaryTranslation: 只要日程允许，她就尽量腾出晚间时间，以平衡工作与家庭生活。

english: physical harm that is done to something
primaryExample: The storm caused considerable damage to the roof, although the rooms below remained dry throughout the night.
primaryTranslation: 暴风雨对屋顶造成了严重破坏，不过下面的房间整夜仍然干燥。

english: starting situation, fact, idea to develop from
primaryExample: The survey provides a useful basis for discussion, but we should hear residents' views before making a decision.
primaryTranslation: 调查为讨论提供了有用基础，但我们在决定前应听取居民意见。

english: person who writes books, plays, poems, etc.
primaryExample: The author visited our school to explain how a childhood memory had inspired her most recent story.
primaryTranslation: 作者来到我们学校，解释一段童年记忆如何启发了她最新的故事。

english: at the most important or easiest (beginner) level
primaryExample: The course covers basic skills such as measuring and cutting, before moving on to more complicated projects.
primaryTranslation: 课程先介绍测量、切割等基本技能，然后进入更复杂的项目。

english: to make someone more determined or confident
primaryExample: The club hopes to encourage more families to cycle by showing them safer routes around the town.
primaryTranslation: 俱乐部希望通过介绍镇上更安全的路线，鼓励更多家庭骑车。

english: long thin strands on your head or body
primaryExample: She tied her hair back before starting the experiment, as the safety instructions required everyone to do.
primaryTranslation: 她开始实验前把头发扎到后面，安全说明要求所有人都这样做。

english: characteristic of boys or men
primaryExample: The wildlife guide explained how male birds sometimes use bright feathers to attract attention during spring.
primaryTranslation: 野生动物向导解释了雄鸟有时如何在春天用鲜艳羽毛吸引注意。

english: to be working or being used
primaryExample: Only trained staff can operate the machine because its moving parts could be dangerous if used incorrectly.
primaryTranslation: 只有受过培训的员工才能操作这台机器，因为使用不当时其活动部件可能危险。

english: to bounce back off a surface (e.g., light)
primaryExample: The large windows reflect the afternoon sunlight, making the building appear brighter when viewed from across the river.
primaryTranslation: 大窗户反射午后的阳光，从河对岸看时，大楼显得更明亮。

english: to work out to become stronger and healthier
primaryExample: Regular exercise became easier to maintain once she found a walking group that met near her home.
primaryTranslation: 找到一个在家附近集合的步行小组后，她更容易坚持定期锻炼了。

english: that can help with a particular task
primaryExample: The map proved useful when our phones lost signal and we needed to find another route home.
primaryTranslation: 手机没有信号、我们需要寻找其他回家路线时，这张地图派上了用场。

english: place where you can order, buy and eat a meal
primaryExample: We chose a restaurant that served local dishes, although we had to wait until a table became available.
primaryTranslation: 我们选了一家供应当地菜的餐馆，不过不得不等到有空桌。

english: earned money from work, investments, or business
primaryExample: Their income changes from month to month because both parents work on projects rather than receiving fixed salaries.
primaryTranslation: 他们家的收入每月不同，因为父母双方都按项目工作，而不是领固定工资。

english: things, buildings, or pieces of land owned by someone
primaryExample: The property includes a small garden, which the previous owner used to grow vegetables for the family.
primaryTranslation: 这处房产包括一个小花园，前任屋主曾用它为家人种蔬菜。

english: existing or happening before the present time
primaryExample: My previous job involved travelling frequently, whereas my current role allows me to work much closer to home.
primaryTranslation: 我上一份工作需要经常出差，而现在的职位让我能在离家近得多的地方工作。

english: having little or no light; not light in color
primaryExample: The room became too dark to read comfortably, so I moved my chair closer to the window.
primaryTranslation: 房间变得太暗，无法舒服地阅读，所以我把椅子挪到了窗边。

english: to think creatively about; form a mental picture of
primaryExample: Try to imagine how the village looked before the bridge was built and most visitors arrived by boat.
primaryTranslation: 试着想象建桥以前村庄的样子，那时多数访客乘船到来。

english: yes; alright
primaryExample: Okay, we can change the meeting time, provided everyone receives the new details before they leave home.
primaryTranslation: 好的，我们可以改会议时间，前提是所有人在离家前都收到新安排。

english: to get money for work
primaryExample: She began to earn extra money by repairing clothes for neighbours after finishing her evening sewing course.
primaryTranslation: 完成晚间缝纫课程后，她开始为邻居修补衣服，赚取额外收入。

english: a female child of someone
primaryExample: Their daughter chose to volunteer at the museum because she wanted to learn more about local history.
primaryTranslation: 他们的女儿选择在博物馆做志愿者，因为她想更多地了解当地历史。

english: to send a letter or package using the post office
primaryExample: I will post the signed form tomorrow, so it should reach your office before the closing date.
primaryTranslation: 我明天把签好的表格寄出，应该能在截止日期前送到你的办公室。

english: sheets of paper (or online) containing news stories
primaryExample: The local newspaper published an article about the volunteers who had restored the old path beside the river.
primaryTranslation: 当地报纸刊登了一篇文章，介绍那些修复河边旧小路的志愿者。

english: to explain the meaning of words
primaryExample: Before we begin the discussion, we should define the key terms so that everyone understands them in the same way.
primaryTranslation: 讨论开始前，我们应该定义关键术语，让所有人的理解保持一致。

english: judgment or opinion after thinking for a while
primaryExample: We reached the same conclusion after comparing the results, although we had used different methods to collect the information.
primaryTranslation: 比较结果后，我们得出了相同的结论，尽管收集信息的方法不同。

english: a device that shows the time
primaryExample: The clock above the entrance had stopped, so nobody noticed how late it was until the caretaker arrived.
primaryTranslation: 入口上方的钟停了，所以直到管理员到来，才有人注意到已经这么晚了。

english: every person; everyone
primaryExample: Everybody brought something for the picnic, which meant we had far more food than we could finish.
primaryTranslation: 每个人都带了些野餐食物，结果食物远远多得吃不完。

english: Saturday and Sunday
primaryExample: We spent the weekend repairing the garden fence, taking breaks whenever the rain became too heavy to continue.
primaryTranslation: 我们整个周末都在修花园围栏，每当雨大到无法继续时就休息。

english: to carry out an action well or successfully
primaryExample: The students will perform a short experiment to show how different materials react when they are heated.
primaryTranslation: 学生们将做一个简短实验，展示不同材料受热时如何反应。

english: about a job such as a doctor, lawyer, accountant, etc.
primaryExample: She sought professional advice before signing the contract because some of its conditions were difficult to understand.
primaryTranslation: 签合同前，她寻求了专业意见，因为其中有些条款难以理解。

english: that thing that belongs to me
primaryExample: The notebook beside your bag is mine, but you are welcome to use it if you need paper.
primaryTranslation: 你包旁边的笔记本是我的，不过需要纸时你可以用。

english: general public discussion of a topic
primaryExample: The debate about the new sports centre continued for weeks, with residents expressing different views about its location.
primaryTranslation: 关于新体育中心的辩论持续了数周，居民对选址表达了不同观点。
